url.title: URL
url.description: URL of the Meraki Dashboard API endpoint.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Meraki API key. Set either this or bearer_token_file.

bearer_token_file.title: Bearer token file
bearer_token_file.description: Path to a file containing the Meraki bearer token, reread for each request. Set either this or api_key.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Complete collection or connection-check timeout, in seconds, including all pages and request pacing.

vnode.title: Virtual node
vnode.description: Associates the organization summary with a [Virtual Node](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/organize-systems-metrics-and-alerts#virtual-nodes). Device nodes are created separately.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: HTTP proxy URL. Empty value uses environment proxy variables.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Path to a CA certificate file used to verify the server certificate.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Path to a client certificate file. Requires tls_key.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Path to the client certificate key file. Requires tls_cert.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip verification of the server certificate and hostname.

timeout.ui:help: This budget covers a whole collection, including authentication-file reads, pagination and pacing. Increase it if a large organization cannot finish within the budget.
